title: Teddy Bear Sunflower x2 Plug Plants Unusual Sunflower
description:
The Teddy Bear sunflower is a compact, bushy plant with many branches. It produces numerous double blooms that feel soft when touched, displaying the bright color and characteristic center of typical sunflowers.



 Growing to a moderate height, these sunflowers work well in mixed beds and borders, adding yellow color to gardens. They can be cut for indoor arrangements. Their fluffy blooms attract important pollinators.



 These hardy annuals grow easily in full sun or partial shade with minimal care. Their small size makes them suitable for compact gardens or containers. They have received RHS awards.
